title: Anthropic launches Claude Science for full AI-driven research #claudescience #aiscience #anthropic
description: Anthropic launched Claude Science, a desktop app that automates conducting full scientific experiments and writing research papers. Claude Science integrates over 60 scientific databases and runs parallel specialist agents to analyze literature, process data, and create publication-ready figures with full traceability. This innovation accelerates research workflows by enabling precise reproducibility and transparency, critical for peer review. It has notably reduced genomic analysis time at UCSF by 90% and helped the Allen Institute quickly draft a comprehensive 100-page scientific review. Claude Science represents a significant step in AI-assisted scientific discovery, enhancing accuracy and efficiency across research institutions. Claude Science is currently available in public beta for Claude Pro users on Mac and Linux, marking a new era of AI integration in laboratory research. #Anthropic #ClaudeScience #AIinScience #ScientificResearch #ResearchAutomation #UCSF #AllenInstitute #AIResearchTool #GenomicAnalysis #ScientificSoftware #ClaudePro #MacAI #LinuxAI #AIResearchAssistant #AIResearchInnovation
